heading: Find a time that works for you
intro: Pick a time below and you will get a confirmation email with everything you need. If none of the times work, use the contact page and we will find one.
oneOnOneNote: Sessions are private and held by video or phone.
groupNote: Ten seats per group, so it stays small and safe. When a month fills, you will be offered the next one.
policies: You will get a confirmation email with the link as soon as you book.
Please give 24 hours' notice if you need to reschedule, so the time can go to someone else.
Payment is due before your session — Zelle, PayPal, or Venmo all work.
If you are in crisis or in danger right now, please do not wait for an appointment. Call 911, or the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233.
